case_name: Aman Seth vs State Of Uttarakhand

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Aman Seth, Sanjay Kumar Seth, Arti Seth and Abhimanu Seth (husband, father, wife and son)
parties.respondent_defendant: State of Uttarakhand, Home Secretary, Station House Officer Police Station Raipur, Smt. Neha Seth (wife)

facts_of_case: Petitioners sought quashing of First Information Report dated 28.11.2012, registered as Crime No. 155 of 2012, relating to offences punishable under section 498A, 323 and 504 of I.P.C., and one punishable under section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

legal_principles.principle: Abuse of process of law is not permitted.
legal_principles.held: It is contended that after filing the joint divorce petition under section 13B of Hindu Marriage Act, the respondent no. 3 has got lodged the First Information Report only to pressurize the petitioner no.1, against him and his family members, which is abuse of process of law.

legal_principles.principle: A First Information Report should mention the demand of dowry and when it was made.
legal_principles.held: It is contended that there is no mention whatsoever in the First Information Report as to what was the demand of dowry and when it was made.

outcome.final_order: Urgency Application No. 783 of 2013 is allowed. Interim relief granted to petitioners not to be arrested in connection with Crime No. 155 of 2012, during investigation.

use_for_drafting: quashing a FIR in a domestic violence case
seeking interim relief in a criminal writ petition
